name: API Feature Bento
description: Dark 2-column feature bento of four cards over a faint vertical-line backdrop: Customizable Themes with floating version chips, Advanced search with a command-palette mock (status badges), a wide Pavyon API browser/IDE mock (nav, API file tree, syntax-highlighted code), and Cosmic API with an animated paired bar chart.
interactions: cards fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-afb-up, staggered 80ms per card)
version chips float gently: translateY +/-7px, 5s ease-in-out infinite, per-chip delay, each keeping its tilt via a --afb-rot custom property
Cosmic bar chart: bars scaleY 0 -> 1 from the baseline once in view, 800ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), per-bar transition-delay
cards lift 3px and brighten their border on hover (250ms)
prefers-reduced-motion: chip float + bar grow + hover off, everything rendered in final state
